exchange_session_ref.note: half-days, special closures and changes over history must come from an official, versioned source

calendar_ref.rule: outside coverage = unknown; never fall back to weekday assumption for completion
calendar_ref.repository_status: SZSE 2019-09..2026-06 official months; SSE not independently accepted

price_item.complete_at: 1d = trading-day close; 1w = close of the calendar's last trading day of that week; 1M likewise; all-closed week has no bar; uncovered = null
price_item.is_complete_at_observation: derived, never stored as a constant
price_item.revision_id: v0 first release; later versions appended with revised_at
price_item.missing: true when the feed is not connected or the bar is absent

depends_on: list of item ids (all timeframes used)
decision.decidable_at: max(known_at of all items); any unknown => decision status unknown
decision.versions_used: item -> revision_id visible at observation time

intraday_after_hourly_confirmation.execute_at: first tradable moment after decidable_at within sessions
intraday_after_hourly_confirmation.status: research design only; no hourly data connected

weekly_action.evaluate_at: close of the last trading day of the week containing the signal
weekly_action.rule: re-check every condition with data known at evaluate_at; a signal that no longer holds is not executed
weekly_action.execute_at: next trading day open; unknown if outside calendar coverage

month_end_action.evaluate_at: close of the last trading day of the month

hourly_status: not_connected: lower-timeframe confirmation must be reported as unknown, never as 'not confirmed' and never replaced by daily OHLC proxies
observed_at_rule: must carry a timezone; naive datetimes rejected (production classify_a_share_bar currently assumes Shanghai)
